{{Current events|year=2026|month=07|day=16|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2026 Iran war]]
**[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
***[[2026 Iran war ceasefire]]
****[[White House Press Secretary]] [[Karoline Leavitt]] says that [[Iran]] is still interested in an agreement with the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-continues-talk-us-wants-make-deal-white-house-says-2026-07-16/ (Reuters)]
**[[July 2026 United States strikes against Iran]]
***The [[United States Central Command]] launches new strikes against Iran for a sixth consecutive night in an effort to degrade Iranian military capabilities. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/us-forces-launch-new-strikes-against-iran-us-military-says (''Middle East Eye'')]
***Explosions are reported in Iran's [[Qeshm Island]], [[Bushehr]], [[Ahvaz]], and [[Bandar Abbas]], including a bridge in [[Bandar Khamir]]. A truck on the bridge is reported to be targeted, killing the driver. [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/explosions-hit-qeshm-bushehr-bandar-abbas-as-us-opens-sixth-night-of-iran-strikes-3224049 (''Turkiye Today'')]
***[[Tasnim News Agency]] reports that [[List of United States fighter aircraft|American fighter jets]] attacked the [[Iranshahr Airport]] in the [[Sistan and Baluchestan province|Sistan and Baluchestan]] [[Provinces of Iran|province]]. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/elho8dlz7 (Ynetnews)] [https://www.mtv.com.lb/en/news/International/1718298/tasnim-news-agency--three-powerful-explosions-were-heard-near-iranshahr-airport-in-iran-s-southeastern-sistan-and-baluchestan-province (MTV)]
**[[Kuwait in the 2026 Iran war]]
***The [[Ministry of Defense (Kuwait)|Kuwaiti defense ministry]] reports that [[Kuwait Armed Forces|the military]] intercepted and destroyed 32 drones entering [[Kuwait|the country]]'s [[airspace]]. [https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/32-drones-shot-down-as-iran-targets-kuwaits-vital-installations/ (''Arab Times Kuwait'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Sudanese refugee crisis]]
***Around 1,000 Sudanese returnees in [[Egypt]] are reported by a local committee to have returned to [[Sudan|Sudan]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260716-1000-more-sudanese-return-home-from-egypt-committee-says/?amp (Middle East Monitor)]
**The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] says that they have destroyed around 205 combat vehicles, military supply trucks, and four strategic drones belonging to the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in the past two weeks. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/sudan-s-army-says-it-destroyed-205-rsf-combat-vehicles-downed-4-drones-this-month/4000839 (AA)] [https://sudantribune.com/article/316303 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**Five insurgents are revealed to have been killed and several others injured in recent clashes last month involving the [[Mozambican Army]] and the [[Islamic State]] near Catupa, [[Cabo Delgado]], [[Mozambique]]. [https://moz24h.co.mz/cinco-alegados-insurgentes-mortos-por-militares-em-macomia-mocambique/ (Moz24)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twenty-one people are killed and several others are injured after a bus lost control and veered off the road in [[Kapchorwa]], [[Uganda]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260717/ea79d169a6c9414e87d3bedc224a50ed/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Fourteen people are killed and five others are injured after a minibus plunged into a deep ravine in [[Cajamarca]], [[Peru]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260717/9e2c7b7d78eb46e8a27c248195e9f220/c.html (Xinhua)]
*Eleven people are killed and 19 more injured in a fire at a [[Nursing home|care facility]] in [[Algiers]], [[Algeria]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgwd4nz344o (BBC News)]
*Six members of a family are killed after a fire engulfed their house in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260716/2c4920fc8aef4d869da5947b12d6eabd/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[Ministry of Health (Uganda)|Ugandan health ministry]] reports that [[Uganda]] has discharged its last patient diagnosed with [[Ebola]], triggering a 42-day countdown clock on when it can be declared free of the virus. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uganda-discharge-last-ebola-patient-spokesperson-says-2026-07-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
**''[[The Washington Post]]'' links the [[iceberg lettuce]] produced by [[Taylor Farms]] and supplied to American [[Fast-food restaurant|fast food]] chain [[Taco Bell]] as a source of the current [[cyclosporiasis]] outbreak in the [[United States]], which is caused by ''[[Cyclospora cayetanensis]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/taco-bell-lettuce-supplied-by-taylor-farms-linked-us-cyclosporiasis-outbreak-2026-07-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2026/07/16/lettuce-supplier-is-potential-source-cyclosporiasis-outbreak-investigators-say/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**Taco Bell removes [[lettuce]] from some of their restaurants following reports that the [[Food and Drug Administration]] has opened an investigation into iceberg lettuce supplied to them. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/5973299-taco-bell-removes-lettuce-cyclosporiasis/ (''The Hill'')]
**The [[Michigan Department of Health and Human Services]] reports that the amount of hospitalizations in [[Michigan|the state]] linked to the cyclosporiasis outbreak has surpassed 100 people. [https://abcnews.com/Health/cyclosporiasis-cases-michigan-surpass-2600-health-officials/story?id=134709100 (ABC News)]
*[[Zambia]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Zambia)|health ministry]] declares an end to its [[cholera]] outbreak, which started in August of last year, after four weeks without a case. [https://www.lusakatimes.com/2026/07/16/government-puts-an-end-to-cholera-outbreak/ (''Lusaka Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Papua New Guinea–Taiwan relations]]
**[[Taiwan]] says that its [[Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office|representative office]] in [[Port Moresby]] will continue operating and assisting [[Taiwanese nationality law|Taiwanese national]]s, rejecting [[Papua New Guinea]]'s decision to close it and stating that the move was made without prior consultation. [[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Papua New Guinea)|Papuan foreign minister]] [[Justin Tkatchenko]] says that his ministry informed Taiwan of the closure "weeks ago". [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/china-says-papua-new-guinea-has-closed-taiwans-office-in-the-country (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Sudan–United Arab Emirates relations]], [[War crimes during the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|War crimes during the Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Ministry of Justice (Sudan)|Sudanese justice minister]] Abdallah Dirif says that [[Government of Sudan|the government]] will launch lawsuits against the [[United Arab Emirates]] in [[international court]]s for its role in supporting [[war crime]]s by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in the ongoing [[civil war]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/316320 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Thailand]]
**The [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Ministry of Interior (Thailand)|interior ministry]] identifies irregularities in the mandatory [[Civil service entrance examination|examination]] results of 5,814 [[Government of Thailand|civil servants]] and considers suspensions, while [[Royal Thai Police|police]] arrest three suspected organizers following a joint investigation with [[National Anti-Corruption Commission (Thailand)|the anti-corruption commission]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/thailand-considers-suspending-nearly-6000-officials-over-exam-scandal (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*[[Huachicol fiscal]], [[Organized crime in Mexico]]
**[[Ernesto Ruffo Appel]], former [[governor of Baja California|governor]] of [[Baja California]], [[Mexico]], is arrested on charges related to [[organized crime]] and [[fuel]] [[smuggling]]. [https://ggnorth.com/2026/07/ex-governor-ernesto-ruffo-arrested-in-ensenada/ (''Gringo Gazette'')]
*[[Unification Church and politics]]
**[[South Korea]]'s [[Supreme Court of Korea|Supreme Court]] upholds [[People Power Party]] lawmaker [[Kweon Seong-dong]]'s two-year prison sentence for [[Corruption in South Korea|accepting]] [[South Korean won|₩]]100 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]67,400) in [[Bribery|illegal political funds]] from the [[Unification Church]], removing him from the [[National Assembly (South Korea)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-top-court-upholds-jail-term-for-mp-over-church-bribes (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*Former [[Autostrade per l'Italia]] (ASPI) [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Giovanni Castellucci]] is convicted and sentenced to 12 years in prison for his role in the [[Ponte Morandi collapse|2018 collapse]] of the [[Ponte Morandi]] in [[Genoa]], [[Liguria]], [[Italy]], which killed 43 people. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2026/07/16/ex-aspi-ceo-castellucci-gets-12-years-as-morandi-bridge-disaster-verdicts-handed_4e21ef9e-216e-4cbd-ac5c-d759d8611c5d.html (ANSA)] [https://www.trasportoeuropa.it/english/convictions-at-first-instance-over-the-ponte-morandi-collapse/ (TrasportoEuropa)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Dismissal of Mykhailo Fedorov]]
**Protests take place in [[Kyiv]] and other cities across [[Ukraine]] against [[President of Ukraine|president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]'s decision to replace [[Minister of Defense (Ukraine)|defense minister]] [[Mykhailo Fedorov]] with major-general [[Yevhenii Khmara]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx76069n3do (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-parliament-elect-new-government-amid-outcry-over-defence-chief-2026-07-16/ (Reuters)]
**[[Ukrainian Air Force]] deputy commander [[Pavlo Yelizarov]] resigns from his position in protest of Fedorov's removal as defense minister. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx76069n3do (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
* Astronomers report the first observationally confirmed atmosphere around a [[Terrestrial planet|rocky]] [[exoplanet]] within its [[LHS 1140|star]]'s [[habitable zone]], after detecting [[helium]] escaping from the upper atmosphere of [[LHS 1140 b]], a [[super-Earth]] approximately 49 light-years from [[Earth]]. [https://www.space.com/astronomy/exoplanets/astronomers-discover-1st-atmosphere-around-a-rocky-earth-like-planet-in-the-habitable-zone (Space.com)]
